recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: whispers of culture shifts inside big AI labs
remote product engineer roles still lighting up hiring boards
spanish cities echo with calls for affordable roofs
clear autumn morning at fifteen degrees in San Francisco
early october sunlight stretching toward an earlier sunset
pocket agents spun up from a phone before the fog rolls in

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Guide a pocket agent through San Francisco fog by drawing brief deployment paths; each path triggers a tiny ship before the mist closes the lane.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one path, one deploy, sixty seconds of flow
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens and valid draw windows shrink each wave
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome fog with neon cursor trails

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort incoming feature requests into parallel agent lanes before standup ends; mismatches spawn merge conflicts you flick away.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying snap when every ticket lands in the right brain
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: request types multiply and lanes narrow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Stack rooftop modules on a tilting row house—each block is a housing unit; physics wobble as distant drum pulses ripple through the foundation.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: tap to drop, hold to rotate
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one clean stack feels like holding the whole skyline steady
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind gusts and foundations grow narrower
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor row houses at golden hour

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap in sync with three parallel models remixing the same melody—drift from the beat and one lane goes silent.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: all three models harmonize for one perfect bar
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tempo shifts and staggered lane mutes
